output.reason: [ev-dea2079e5dc4] says the 1.13 chart no longer enables policy exceptions in all namespaces by default, and that this affects users who relied on that default. The exposed environments are those that use PolicyExceptions outside the newly enabled namespaces and leave the chart's exception setting at its default. A bare gvk-in-use PolicyException is too broad because it also flags environments that set the exception namespaces explicitly. None of the evidence names the Helm values key or its old and new defaults; [ev-b8120a2bb840] only shows the PolicyException v2alpha1 CRD version being removed.
